name: B0452 1MP OV9281 global shutter camera (M12)

sources.title: 1MP OV9281/OV9282 global shutter cameras for Raspberry Pi (Arducam documentation)
sources.covers: sensor (OV9281), shutter, chroma, active pixels, optical format, pixel size; product catalogue row for B0452 (M12 mount, FOV, manual focus, 650 nm IR-cut filter)

note: A small monochrome global-shutter MIPI CSI-2 camera board for Raspberry Pi (22-pin connector) with an M12 lens; the catalogue gives "75 (H) x 59 (V)" degrees for the B0452 and states no diagonal. The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Focus "Manual Focus" (adjustable lens), entered as null (the schema knows fixed and auto). 650 nm IR-cut filter. The page states no frame rate for this module, so no stream is entered; the B0262 (the same sensor, M12) is listed at 75 x 56.3 degrees. Not stated: power, mass, size, f-number, focal length.
